title: astramem-retrieval@1 result envelope
description: Result envelope for the shared retrieval contract (ADR-005). Required core = what EVERY implementation can produce; optional fields = best-effort enrichment (cloud fills more than local today). additionalProperties stays FALSE everywhere: a closed schema with declared optionals gives extensibility AND drift detection. An open schema would legalise the silent divergence that white-paged the cloud dashboard three times. Widened 2026-07-13 (CONTRACT-FREEZE, astragenie/memory#759) to carry cloud's full 15-field hit shape as declared optionals — no field is dropped on either side (see the cloud field-mapping table in the freeze doc).

query.description: Echo of the originating query, for trace correlation. Cloud's top-level `mode` moves here.

type.description: Same 10-value union as atom.v1/v2 `type` (ADR D4). Widened from the original 7 (2026-07-09): preference/task_result/summary were missing even though cloud already returns them — a conformant hit from a real cloud response used to fail this schema.

scope.description: ADR-009 memory scope. private|team|org only. atom@2 cut (2026-07-09): the 'personal' alias tracked as TODO(remove-personal-alias) (astramem-local#115) is dropped from this result enum in the same breaking window.

explanation.description: ScoreExplanation (ADR-005): per-signal raw score, weight, and contribution to the final score.

final.description: Sum of all signal contributions; matches the hit's top-level `score`.

signals.description: Open map keyed by signal name (e.g. bm25, cosine, importance, freshness, usefulness locally; cloud's vector/keyword/importance/recency/usage, including RRF/cross-encoder signals, both validate here).

reason.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-07-13, CONTRACT-FREEZE §2). Human-readable summary. Cloud already emits this (ScoreExplanationDto.reason) and had nowhere to put it under a closed schema; local does not generate one today and omits the key rather than fake it.

importance.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-07-13). Local already stores this (atom@2 requires it) and was projecting it away.

confidence.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-07-13). Cloud's `confidence_score`. Local already stores this (atom@2 requires it).

created_at.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-07-13). Local already stores this (atom@2 requires it).

source.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-07-13). Origin of the memory. Maps to local's `memories.capture_source` column (migration 024).

tags.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-07-13). Cloud only today — local has no tags column, omits the key rather than fake it.

usage_count.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-07-13). Cloud only today — local has no usage_count column, omits the key rather than fake it.

metadata.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-07-13). Free-form; the one place an open map is intentional.

highlights.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-07-13). Cloud's `content_preview_highlights` — character ranges into `text`. Local has no FTS snippet extraction yet, omits the key rather than fake it.

embedding_error.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-07-13, CONTRACT-FREEZE §4.3). Non-null when the embedding provider failed and the result is DEGRADED (keyword-only). Cloud emits this today and it must not be lost — a silently degraded search is the worst failure mode for a memory product. Local's search() already has an equivalent internal fallback (vector search try/catch in search.ts) but does not yet surface the failure reason on the wire — tracked as a follow-up, not implemented in this slice.
